description: This is a Python script for generating and inserting CAMEO tags into OpenWrt firmware images, specifically targeting U-Boot bootloader checks for D-Link DGS-1210 switches. It manipulates uImage headers and root filesystem images to embed specific tags and checksums for boot validation.

methods.name: read_buffer
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the uImage file at a given offset.

methods.name: write_buffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer to the uImage file at a specified position.

methods.name: camesum
methods.description: Calculates a 4-byte checksum sum of a buffer.

methods.name: invertcrc
methods.description: Calculates an inverted CRC32 checksum of a buffer.

methods.name: checksum_header
methods.description: Modifies the uImage header buffer to embed CAMEO tags and checksums, ensuring header integrity.
